title: Age-dependent low serum bicarbonate does not establish incremental grip-strength prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: Among 2,041 source and 2,268 confirmation adults aged 50 or older, adding max(23-bicarbonate,0)*(age-50)/10 to flexible standard predictors changed weighted combined-grip RMSE from 10.944721 to 10.944713 kg; gain 0.00000758 kg (joint PSU-bootstrap 95% interval -0.008349 to 0.009232). No incremental predictive benefit is established; validation is limited to separately sampled cycles of the same survey.
